en.p: As shown in the figure, for the function $f(x)=3x^{2}-7x+2$, let $A$ be the region enclosed by the curve $y=f(x)$, the line $y=\dfrac{1}{3}x-\dfrac{2}{3}$, and the $y$-axis; let $B$ be the region enclosed by the curve $y=f(x)$ and the line $y=\dfrac{1}{3}x-\dfrac{2}{3}$; and let $C$ be the region enclosed by the curve $y=f(x)$ and the two lines $y=\dfrac{1}{3}x-\dfrac{2}{3}$ and $x=k\ (k>2)$.
When the above holds, what is the value of the constant $k$? [4 points]
